design: INDIVIDUAL 18: a lanky elder council assessor with hunched attentive shoulders, sand-grey spotted hide, a low wide alien brow and healed shallow cheek scars without losing any mandible, thick long tendrils bundled entirely over the right shoulder. A simple dark violet sleeveless robe with diagonal bronze-edged sage sash and a double necklace of old circular ranks. Turns one palm upward in explanation while the other holds a small bronze rectangular tally slate down near hip. Legs apart in conversational stance.
